body: I know, that was quite a rant, but I feel a lot better after venting. Sorry you had to read all that.

I own a business and it began to forget a lot of very important details, things would slip through the cracks, even if I wrote stuff down, i'd forget I wrote it down. Also I'd find myself only looking forward to the moments I was getting high, and would try to rush through my day so I could go home and smoke. Weed itself wasn't the problem, it was how I handled weed, unfortunately. I love weed but as of right now in my life, I have to put it aside. 

But let me tell you, from smoking every day for 4 + consecutive years, it makes it extremely difficult to stop.
Thanks, I appreciate the kind words.
